manaNeeded: {0} plus the mana cost of the creature in your hand
easyPrerequisites: Werefox Bodyguard must be exiled by Lumbering Battlement, and Fiend Hunter must begin in hand. (This starting order is not fixed, and their initial positions may be interchanged as necessary.)
description:
Cast Fiend Hunter for its mana cost.
When Fiend Hunter enters, it exiles Lumbering Battlement until Fiend Hunter leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Fiend Hunter's ETB.
When Lumbering Battlement leaves the battlefield, Werefox Bodyguard is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Werefox Bodyguard enters, it exiles Fiend Hunter until Werefox Bodyguard leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Werefox Bodyguard's ETB.
When Fiend Hunter leaves the battlefield, Lumbering Battlement is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Lumbering Battlement enters, it exiles Werefox Bodyguard until Lumbering Battlement leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Lumbering Battlement's ETB.
When Werefox Bodyguard leaves the battlefield, Fiend Hunter is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
